context: Start from a checksummed fixture. Add source-cursor invalidation before regeneration. Regenerate the four known stale summaries from their complete sessions, then rebuild raw memories, registry, and compact summary deterministically. Normalize BenchBox pool paths to the BenchBox repository identity. Keep historical evidence searchable but out of automatic instruction context. Compare the treatment against the baseline scenario corpus before any canary.
description: Create a candidate Codex-memory treatment without mutating the live store. Correct the four rollout summaries whose source sessions materially continued after the recorded checkpoint; add summarized-through event identity/digest; preserve completion stages proposed -> implemented -> committed -> pushed -> merged -> released -> verified; add project_id, source_kind, source_ref, observed_at, observed_commit, freshness_class, reverify_after, supersedes, authority_rank, and sensitivity metadata. Reclassify stale Oxbow/textcharts YAML state, BenchBox schema-2 findings state, PR statuses, canonical SHAs, tracker export counts, and pool/temp paths as dated historical observations rather than current facts. Reduce the global compact summary to stable human-approved preferences plus an exact-project routing index, target <=1,200 approximate tokens, and exclude drift-prone live state. Remove executable memory-generated skills from the candidate after migrating any uniquely useful procedure to the approved authoritative surface. Resolve the contradictory ad-hoc-note authority wording. Derived raw/registry/summary files must be regenerated from corrected upstream records, never patched alone.

anti_patterns.dont: delete historical rollouts merely because their current-state claims expired
anti_patterns.instead: mark them historical and exclude them from automatic current-state context
anti_patterns.why: they retain useful evidence and provenance

anti_patterns.dont: keep branch, PR, version, count, runtime, or pool-slot state in global automatic injection
anti_patterns.instead: retrieve the dated evidence on exact-project demand and verify live
anti_patterns.why: those facts drift and cross-contaminate unrelated projects

anti_patterns.dont: patch memory_summary.md or MEMORY.md without correcting upstream records
anti_patterns.instead: update source metadata/generator and regenerate every derived layer
anti_patterns.why: derived files will drift again on regeneration

preserves.behavior: All 37 rollout references and source-session evidence remain recoverable unless separately approved for deletion
No source transcript or historical evidence is rewritten
Required repository behavior remains authoritative in AGENTS.md or canonical skills, not generated memory
Task-level success, partial, uncertain, and blocked distinctions remain explicit

global compact summary containing project live state
